description: This file defines an API endpoint handler for updating a note by its ID in a notes application. It imports types, processes incoming requests, simulates delay, constructs an updated note object, and returns a success message with the updated note data.

methods.name: defineEventHandler
methods.description: Defines an API endpoint handler for serverless functions or server routes.

methods.name: getRouterParam
methods.description: Retrieves route parameters from the request event, such as the 'id'.

methods.name: readBody
methods.description: Reads and parses the request body payload.

ctags.name: body
ctags.pattern: /^  const body = await readBody(event) as UpdateNoteDto$/
